evidence_summary: Issue #89 is open with zero comments and no assignee.
The issue identifies duplicated toBigInt/toTimestamp/fmt logic across four dashboard files and asks for a single shared module plus unit tests.
Acceptance requires all four dashboard files to import shared helpers and tests covering signed-negative, hi/lo, string, and empty inputs.
